resume: X0X turns the FM-1 into a groovebox: a 909, an 808, two 303s with an acid line generator and a breakbeat player, all together, each with its own pattern. Patterns can be chained into a song and knob movements recorded.

commandes.role: The steps by 16; on HOME and SONG, patterns 1 to 16; on the 303 keyboard, the octave; on TB-3PO, mutes the line.
The steps by 16; on HOME and SONG, patterns 17 to 32; on the 303 keyboard, the octave; on TB-3PO, writes a new line.
The whole screen as a list; in a question, yes.
Held while pressing keys: an accent.
The mixer and master. Held while pressing keys: a slide.
The sound of the chosen part.
The pattern: the five parts, which pattern, the mutes; again, the song. In a list, back.
Saves everything. Held, copies the pattern; a white key pastes it.
The steps of the chosen part, with LENGTH and RATE.
Records: drum hits, 303 notes, knob movements, song. On a 303, the keys become a keyboard.
Previous or next page; in a list, moves.
Next pattern: of the part on its screen, of all parts on HOME.
The steps; on HOME, the patterns.
The drum tracks or the break slices; on HOME, they mute the parts.

gestes: HOME held + REC: undo; + PLAY: redo; + SELECT: tempo.
SAVE held: copies the pattern, then a white key pastes it.
a_savoir: X0X is in beta: a very busy pattern can push the FM-1 to its limit; X0X then sacrifices some sound quality to keep playing.
No recorded break is supplied, only two loops played by its 909.
